value.description: The single number answering the question, copied from your executed query's result. Never null when the answer is one number. Null only when the answer is a list/breakdown.

rows.description: Breakdown answers (by month, category, year, ...). Also use rows when the question asks WHICH item (e.g. which month/category): return that item's label and value. Empty for plain single-number answers.

label.description: Years as YYYY, months as YYYY-MM, otherwise the exact value from the data.
